content.intro: This lesson covers Returning Values Early. It sits in Module 5, Functions, Scope, and Program Flow, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Returning Values Early matters when you work with language foundations. Understanding the rule helps you predict compiler or runtime behavior, document assumptions, and choose a safer implementation when inputs or system conditions change.
